description: HYDROLIB is a Python package developed by Deltares and partner organisations for preparing, running and analysing hydrodynamic modelling workflows. It builds on HYDROLIB-core file interfaces and includes the D-HyDAMO model generator, Profile Optimizer, inundation analysis and case-management tools. Inputs include D-HYDRO models, profile definitions, meteorological scenarios and model outputs; results include revised model cases and flood-arrival or water-level-rise characteristics. Coverage is configurable, with several tools designed around Dutch data conventions and D-HYDRO practice. Public source and examples are free under LGPL-3.0, distinct from HYDROLIB-core's MIT licence. A limitation is that inundation and case-management tools remain under development. The documented profile optimizer changes the bottom width of one non-branching stream; repeated cross-section identifiers can unintentionally change multiple locations. HYDROLIB supports flood-defence and drainage simulations using Delft3D FM (model-delft3d-fm), and requires a suitable model and solver setup. Its documentation gives example workflows and explicit restrictions. No model files, example data or solver binaries were downloaded.
